Container.Name: gods-eye-view
Container.Overview:
God's Eye View: a real-time intelligence console for planet Earth. Photorealistic 3D globe (Cesium + Google 3D Tiles), live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, fires, traffic and CCTV, with hands-free voice control.
This image builds the web bundle on first start (usually well under a minute; watch the log) and then serves it. All API keys are optional; the globe works without any, but Google 3D Tiles need GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY and voice needs OPENAI_API_KEY plus HTTPS. Put it behind your reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager / SWAG) for HTTPS. There is no built-in authentication: anyone who can reach the port can spend your API quota, so do not port-forward it. Unofficial packaging by cenz0h; upstream: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view. Non-commercial use only (bundled TeleGeography cable data is CC BY-NC-SA).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port. Point your HTTPS reverse proxy at this.

Config.Name: Config (API keys)
Config.Description: Holds gev.env, where your API keys belong. Keys placed in this file survive container updates, recreation and template changes; keys typed into the fields below live in the container template and are lost if the template is ever re-applied. An annotated gev.env is created here on first start. Fields below still win over the file when filled in.

Config.Name: Provider cache
Config.Description: Provider caches (terrain heights, satellite TLEs, TomTom daily budget counter). Keep this to avoid re-fetching expensive data.

Config.Name: Logs
Config.Description: Voice conversation debug log (only written when voice is used).

Config.Name: Built web bundle
Config.Description: Built client bundle (~100 MB). Safe to delete; it is rebuilt on the next start.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the app runs as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the app runs as (100 = users).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for log timestamps.

Config.Name: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
Config.Description: Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles and place search. METERED, and the browser calls Google directly so this container cannot cap it. Set daily quotas in the Google Cloud console first and restrict the key by HTTP referrer. For 3D tiles with no Google billing at all, leave this empty and set only CESIUM_ION_TOKEN. Changing it rebuilds the bundle on the next start.

Config.Name: CESIUM_ION_TOKEN
Config.Description: Cesium ion imagery/terrain. Browser-visible: use a public assets:read token. Changing it rebuilds the bundle on the next start.

Config.Name: GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_API_KEY
Config.Description: Server-only Google key for Places (falls back to GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY).

Config.Name: OPENAI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Voice control and HUD summaries. Voice also needs HTTPS via your reverse proxy.

Config.Name: OPENSKY_AUTH_MODE
Config.Description: anon | basic | oauth | auto

Config.Name: OPENSKY_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: OpenSky OAuth client id.

Config.Name: OPENSKY_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: OpenSky OAuth client secret.

Config.Name: OPENSKY_USERNAME
Config.Description: OpenSky basic-auth username (legacy).

Config.Name: OPENSKY_PASSWORD
Config.Description: OpenSky basic-auth password (legacy).

Config.Name: AISSTREAM_API_KEY
Config.Description: Live vessels via aisstream.io.

Config.Name: TOMTOM_API_KEY
Config.Description: Live traffic tiles.

Config.Name: FIRMS_MAP_KEY
Config.Description: NASA FIRMS active fires.

Config.Name: LL2_API_TOKEN
Config.Description: Launch Library 2 token (optional; raises the rate limit).

Config.Name: GEV_RATELIMIT_OPENAI_PER_MIN
Config.Description: Max OpenAI proxy requests per minute per client IP. Behind a reverse proxy this is a global cap. 0 or unset = unlimited.

Config.Name: GEV_RATELIMIT_GOOGLE_PER_MIN
Config.Description: Burst guard for the two server-side Google Places routes, per minute per client IP. NOT a billing cap, and it does not cover the 3D tiles or geocoding that the browser requests straight from Google. Set daily quotas in the Google Cloud console as well. 0 or unset = unlimited.

Config.Name: GEV_FORCE_REBUILD
Config.Description: Set to 1 to rebuild the web bundle on every start (debugging).
